Health and Hygiene (Part 1): Personal Cleanliness and healthy
weeks.content:
Understanding hygiene: keeping our body clean
Daily hygiene practices:
- Bathing daily: morning and/or evening
-Washing hands: before eating, after toilet, after
playing
- Brushing teeth: morning and night, after meals
- Washing face: morning and evening
- Cutting nails: keeping them short and clean
Proper handwashing steps: wet, soap, scrub (20
seconds), rinse, dry
Activity: Handwashing practice, demonstrating
hygiene routines

weeks.topic: Health and Hygiene (Part 2): Body Care tidy
weeks.content:
Hair care: washing regularly, combing, keeping
Ear care: cleaning outer ear gently, not putting
objects inside
Nose care: blowing nose with tissue, keeping
clean
Clothing hygiene: wearing clean clothes daily,
changing underwear
Foot care: washing feet, wearing clean socks,
proper shoes
Why hygiene is important: staying healthy,
smelling good, preventing diseases
Diseases from poor hygiene: stomach ache, skin
infections, lice
Activity: Hygiene checklist, role-playing daily
hygiene routines

weeks.topic: Health and Hygiene (Part 3): Food and Environmental - Washing hands before eating Hygiene - Eating clean, well-cooked food
weeks.content:
Food hygiene:
- Washing fruits and vegetables
- Not eating food that has fallen on ground
- Covering food from flies and insects
Drinking clean water: boiled or filtered water
Environmental hygiene:
- Keeping surroundings clean
- Using dustbins for rubbish
- Not littering
Activity: Clean-up exercise in classroom/school
compound
